name: @hakiiizimana/webmesh
description: Search, fetch, and browse the web from your AI agent.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target bun --outfile dist/webmesh.js --external wreq-js && mkdir -p dist/skills dist/bin && cp -R ../../skills/* dist/skills/ && cp -R ../../packages/core/bin/. dist/bin/ && cp ../../README.md ../../LICENSE .
scripts.prepack: bun run --cwd ../.. build:binaries && bun run build
